# Total population per municipality

To download, go to <https://www.inegi.org.mx/app/descarga/?t=123>, click Temas --> Demografía y Sociedad --> Población --> Población --> Indicadores (Inglés) 1910 - 2050.

Saved at `~/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/census_inegi/estructura_english_00.xlsx`.  

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(mapview)
library(sf)
```

## Read in data

```{r}
population_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/census_inegi/estructura_english_00.xlsx"), skip = 4) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

colnames(population_raw)
```

```{r}
## bring in the municipality to rgn_id code CSV I made...
municipality_to_rgnid <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/municipality_to_rgnid","municipality_to_rgnid.csv")) %>% 
  select(-c("notes","municipio_raw")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(municipio = str_trim(municipio, side = "both"))
```

## Filter to GoC municipalities

```{r}
## filter to only GoC
population_goc <- population_raw %>% 
  mutate(cve_entidad = as.numeric(cve_entidad),
         cve_municipio = as.numeric(cve_municipio)) %>% 
  inner_join(municipality_to_rgnid, by = c("cve_entidad" = "e03","cve_municipio" = "e04")) %>% 
  ## also, filter to municipal total...it does not look like there is as complete of data for the other variables.
  filter(indicador %in% "Total population") %>% 
  select(cve_entidad, desc_entidad, cve_municipio, desc_municipio, indicador, unidad_medida, x2000, x2005, x2010, x2020, rgn_id, directly_coastal)
```

## Save to mazu

```{r}
write_csv(population_goc, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/population_municipal","population_goc_municipality_inegi_2000_2020.csv"))
```
